# Acceptance criteria and the tests behind them

<!-- Generated by `npm run acceptance:doc` from acceptance/traceability.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every acceptance criterion of [scope.md](scope.md) §7 (AC-1 to AC-12 come from the PRD, AC-13 to AC-23 from the scope) with the automated tests that prove it. `npm run acceptance` runs the suite written for Phase 16 (`acceptance/`); `npm test` runs it with everything else, in CI on every change. A test that is renamed or deleted fails `acceptance/traceability.test.ts`, so this list cannot go stale.

The tests use a mock provider and in-memory GitHub, with a real PostgreSQL and the real api, worker and publisher. What they cannot show is what only a real GitHub App, repository or AI provider does; the **Real GitHub** line under a criterion says what to look at in the sandbox check or the pilot ([pilot.md](pilot.md)).

## AC-1

A review triggers once per webhook event.

- `acceptance/endToEnd.test.ts`: a new PR is a queued run with a queued Check Run
- `apps/api/src/webhooks/webhooks.test.ts`: a second event for the same head creates no second run
- `apps/worker/src/processor.test.ts`: processes a run once however many jobs arrive at the same time

**Real GitHub:** Open a PR on the sandbox repository: exactly one run and one Check Run.

## AC-2

One structured summary comment, updated in place.

- `packages/core/src/publisher/publish.test.ts`: the summary comment (FR-20, FR-21, FR-31, FR-32, AC-2)
- `apps/worker/src/publisher.test.ts`: updates the same summary comment on a later run for the PR
- `acceptance/endToEnd.test.ts`: the worker reviews it: one inline comment, one summary

## AC-3

A high-confidence issue becomes an inline comment.

- `packages/core/src/publisher/publish.test.ts`: the inline review (FR-17, FR-18, FR-33, AC-3)
- `apps/worker/src/publisher.test.ts`: completes the Check Run, posts one review and one summary

**Real GitHub:** GitHub accepts the review positions on a real diff (the sandbox check).

## AC-4

Low-confidence and info findings produce no inline comment.

- `packages/core/src/publisher/publish.test.ts`: keeps lower items out of the inline review (AC-4)
- `apps/worker/src/publisher.test.ts`: a review with no findings says so

## AC-5

Missing tests are labelled as suggestions, never as measured coverage.

- `packages/core/src/agents/testCoverage/testCoverage.test.ts`: Test Coverage agent: no coverage report (AC-5)
- `apps/worker/src/coverage.test.ts`: completes with coverage not available when CI uploaded nothing
- `apps/web/src/pages/runDetail.test.tsx`: labels a test suggestion as a suggestion, not a measurement

## AC-6

LCOV coverage from a CI artifact is reported for the changed lines.

- `packages/core/src/agents/testCoverage/testCoverage.test.ts`: Test Coverage agent: with a coverage artifact (AC-6)
- `apps/worker/src/coverage.test.ts`: measures changed-line coverage from the artifact and stores it with the run

**Real GitHub:** A coverage artifact uploaded by the sandbox repository's CI is found and read.

## AC-7

A critical security fixture reaches the summary and the Check Run.

- `packages/core/src/agents/security/security.test.ts`: AC-7: a critical finding reaches the summary and the Check Run
- `apps/worker/src/security.test.ts`: stores the finding, calls it out in the summary and the Check Run

## AC-8

Invalid model output or a timeout gives a safe partial result.

- `packages/core/src/agents/orchestrator.test.ts`: runReview: failure isolation (AC-8)
- `apps/worker/src/hardening.test.ts`: a model that obeys completely and answers off-schema yields no findings

## AC-9

Fork PRs never receive provider keys or execute code, and are skipped unless an administrator opts in.

- `packages/core/src/sourceGuards.test.ts`: no repository code is ever executed or checked out (AC-9)
- `packages/core/src/sourceGuards.test.ts`: fork pull requests are skipped unless an administrator opts in (AC-9)
- `apps/worker/src/hardening.test.ts`: fork pull requests (AC-9, AC-23)

**Real GitHub:** A PR from a fork of the sandbox repository is skipped with the reason.

## AC-10

A rerun on the same SHA adds no duplicate comments.

- `acceptance/endToEnd.test.ts`: a re-run is a new run linked to the old one, and the second review adds no duplicate
- `packages/core/src/publisher/publish.test.ts`: does not post a finding that was already posted for this head SHA
- `packages/core/src/publisher/publish.test.ts`: also uses the markers GitHub already holds for this head SHA

## AC-11

Ignored, generated and lock files are excluded and reported.

- `packages/core/src/context/collect.test.ts`: collectContext: exclusions (FR-08, FR-10, AC-11)

## AC-12

`fail_on_threshold` fails the check only at the threshold.

- `acceptance/enforcement.test.ts`: the conclusion rule, mode by mode (AC-12)
- `acceptance/enforcement.test.ts`: the same decision through the worker and the publisher (AC-12)

**Real GitHub:** The check shows as failed on a sandbox PR with a planted bug, and the repository's required-check setting decides whether it blocks.

## AC-13

A webhook with an invalid or missing signature is rejected and creates nothing.

- `apps/api/src/webhooks/webhooks.test.ts`: signature verification (AC-13)
- `packages/core/src/github/webhook.test.ts`: webhook signature (AC-13)

## AC-14

Redelivering a delivery ID creates no second run.

- `apps/api/src/webhooks/webhooks.test.ts`: delivery recording and idempotency (AC-14)
- `apps/api/src/hardening.test.ts`: the same 200 deliveries sent again create nothing new

## AC-15

A push to an open PR supersedes the in-flight run; no stale inline comments are posted.

- `apps/api/src/webhooks/webhooks.test.ts`: synchronize supersedes the older queued run for the same PR (AC-15)
- `packages/db/src/supersede.test.ts`: supersedes older queued and running runs of the same PR
- `apps/worker/src/publisher.test.ts`: a run superseded while it is reviewing posts nothing and closes its own Check Run
- `apps/worker/src/publisher.test.ts`: a pull request that moved while the review ran: nothing is posted

## AC-16

A new PR shows as pending in the dashboard and as a queued Check Run within about 5 seconds.

- `apps/api/src/webhooks/webhooks.test.ts`: opened: creates a queued run with a queued Check Run and a job (AC-16)
- `apps/web/src/hooks/useRunEvents.test.tsx`: a run changes status in the list without a page refresh (AC-16)
- `acceptance/performance.test.ts`: webhook accepted -> run queued: p95 under 3 seconds

**Real GitHub:** Stopwatch on the sandbox repository: PR opened -> queued Check Run and a pending row in the dashboard.

## AC-17

A signed-in user sees only the repositories they can access; others return 404/403.

- `apps/api/src/authorization.test.ts`: a user of another tenant: 404, identical to a resource that does not exist
- `apps/api/src/routes.test.ts`: the authorisation matrix covers every contract endpoint
- `packages/db/src/rls.test.ts`: has a policy on every table that carries an installation id
- `packages/db/src/isolation.test.ts`: has a case for every function the tenant layer exports

## AC-18

Provider keys never appear in API responses, logs, prompts or posted comments, and are stored encrypted.

- `apps/api/src/canary.test.ts`: the credential listing shows provider, last four characters and a time
- `apps/worker/src/hardening.test.ts`: secrets in the repository and the pull request never reach the model, the logs, GitHub or the database
- `apps/worker/src/hardening.test.ts`: the encrypted key in the database does not contain the plaintext
- `apps/worker/src/publisher.test.ts`: never posts a planted secret, and never logs it
- `packages/core/src/crypto/envelope.test.ts`: never stores the secret in the clear

## AC-19

Finding feedback is persisted and changes the analytics metrics.

- `apps/api/src/insights.test.ts`: changes when feedback is given (AC-19)
- `acceptance/endToEnd.test.ts`: feedback is stored and moves the analytics (AC-19)

## AC-20

Run history stays filterable and complete for the retention window; cleanup removes older data.

- `apps/worker/src/retention.test.ts`: removes a run's agent runs, findings, comments and feedback together, in one pass (AC-20)
- `apps/api/src/runs.test.ts`: filters by status, a list of statuses, branch, author and severity
- `apps/api/src/runs.test.ts`: filters by the time the run was queued

## AC-21

Re-run from the dashboard creates a linked new run for the same PR and head SHA.

- `apps/api/src/runActions.test.ts`: queues a new run linked to the old one, for the commit the pull request points at now
- `acceptance/endToEnd.test.ts`: a re-run is a new run linked to the old one

## AC-22

Uninstalling the App deactivates the installation: no runs, data hidden, retention applies.

- `apps/api/src/hardening.test.ts`: uninstall: stops what was waiting, forgets the keys and who could see the data
- `apps/worker/src/retention.test.ts`: purges an installation uninstalled longer ago than the window

**Real GitHub:** Uninstall the App from the sandbox repository: the dashboard hides it and a new PR creates no run.

## AC-23

Quotas stop new runs when a per-installation limit is exceeded and record a skipped run with the reason.

- `apps/api/src/hardening.test.ts`: the daily quota stops new runs and records a skipped run with the reason
- `apps/api/src/hardening.test.ts`: the queue limit of an installation skips the run that would be one too many
- `packages/core/src/providers/providers.test.ts`: stops starting requests once the token budget is spent
